units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 6:5">Targ. Gen. VI, 5</cite> (h. text <he>רק</he>); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 21b:15">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>גברי ל׳ ונשי ל׳</he> the men separately and the women separately.

<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:15">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>עני שיעורא ל׳ וכהן שיעורא ל׳</he> there is a separate (different) standard of time for the poor man (when he goes to his meal) and another for the priest (when he goes to eat T’rumah), opp. <he>חד שיעורא</he> the same time.

Ḥull. 55ᵃ ניקב ל׳ ונחתך ל׳ a perforated milt is one thing, and a removed one another (the laws are different); a. fr.—With suff. לְחוֹדִי, בִּלְחוֹדִי for, by myself, לְחוֹדָךְ, בִּלְחוֹדָךְ for, by thyself &c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 18:14">Targ. O. Ex. XVIII, 14</cite> <he>בלחודך</he>; Y. <he>לְבִלְחוֹדָךְ</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a:16">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>אזל הוא לְחוֹדֵיה לגביה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לחודאי גביה</he>, corr. acc.) he went to him by himself.
Men. 38ᵃ כל חד לחודיה each for itself (one independent of the other), opp. תרוייהו בחד both combined as one; a. fr.—וּבִלְ׳ (= h. ובלבד, v. בַּד III) provided, but.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:15">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top <he>ובל׳ דלא יעביד וכ׳</he> provided that he does not do &c., v. <cite ref="H01602"><he>חַרְדּוֹנָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:56">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>וב׳ דלא יתוב ליה</he> provided that he does not return to it (his sin); a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 52:7">Targ. Ps. LII, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:23">Ib. CXIX, 23</cite> Ms. (ed. <he>ארום</he>); <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:24">ib. 24</cite>.
